Marissa, Jonas — attaching the custody SOP and an explanatory note. Summary below.

Summary (for Lumen):
- We operate a dual custody model for private deployments: customer-managed HSM for tenant keys (when requested) and Redwood-managed KMS for platform resources. The SOP documents handover steps for key material, documented approvals (two-person signoff), and a time-bound custody log.
- For Hosted instances we use a multi-tenant KMS namespace with per-tenant key isolation; access to key operations is restricted via role-based policies.
- We redacted internal runbook sections that reference on-call pager rotations; redacted sections are noted in the PDF.

If Lumen needs raw HSM export (audit-only) we require a Data Processing Agreement addendum — flagging now.

Alice / LumenBank team — please find the requested artifacts attached. Short descriptions are inline below each attachment.

Attachments included:
- keystore_custody_sop.pdf — Custody SOP (redacted). Contains custody handover checklist, roles (Custodian A / Custodian B), required approvals, and retention policy. For private deployments we note an HSM escrow process; for hosted we describe per-tenant encryption key isolation.

- ci_approver_matrix.csv — CSV snapshot of current approver matrix (name, role, teams permitted to merge to protected branches). This reflects branch-protection rules enforced by CI gate (merge blocked until required approvals and passing pipeline).

- pr_enforcement_playbook.docx — Playbook describing the enforcement flow: policy check steps in CI, automatic reverts for policy violations, and emergency merge exception steps (requires two executive approvals and an annotated Jira ticket).

- secrets_rotation_excerpt.csv — sample export showing one rotation event (rotated by automation job), timestamp, operator id (system account), and rotation result. PII/secret values redacted. Full rotation logs are audit-only and available under NDA.

Notes / caveats:
- We removed internal pager schedule details and contributor emails. Redactions are labeled in the SOP and CSV exports.
- If you require encrypted handover artifacts (HSM audit export) please confirm the legal addendum; we can schedule a secured transfer with our Compliance team.

Next steps: if this package looks sufficient, please confirm via reply and we will upload the same set to the secure folder you prefer (Drive link or DocuSign).
